|game_text='''0 side — Ralltiir Operations (V)'''

Deploy Ralltiir system. For remainder of game, spaceport sites are immune to He Hasn't Come Back Yet and Ounee Ta. Your Force generation is +1 at each Ralltiir location. Once per battle, when you draw battle destiny, may exchange a card in hand with a card of same card type in Lost Pile. While this side up, once per turn, may ▼ a site (or non-unique Imperial) to Ralltiir. Flip this card if Imperials control at least three Ralltiir sites and opponent controls no Ralltiir locations.

'''7 side — In The Hands Of The Empire (V)'''

Immediately, may ▲ any one card. While this side up, opponent's Force drains are -1 at non-Ralltiir locations. Your total battle destiny is +X, where X = number of Ralltiir locations your Imperials occupy. Always Thinking With Your Stomach is canceled. Flip this card and place a card from hand on Used Pile (if possible) if opponent controls at least two Ralltiir locations.
|hatnote=For the Decipher card, see [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]. This virtual card was blanked (removed from the game) on 15 July 2023 (see History below). Other versions of this card: [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1), [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2).

Flip this card if Imperials control at least three Ralltiir sites and opponent controls no Ralltiir locations.” 7 side: “While this side up, opponent's Force drains are -1 at their locations. Your total battle destiny is +X, where X = number of Ralltiir locations your Imperials occupy. Both sides print “E1”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].

== History ==
Released in [[Virtual Set 10]] (8 January 2019).<ref name="cardjson">[https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/main/DarkPreErrata.json DarkPreErrata.json], swccg-card-json, gempId 210_42. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013152747/https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/main/DarkPreErrata.json Internet Archive]</ref> The original text deployed any Ralltiir system, made spaceport sites immune to all versions of [[Ounee Ta]], gave +1 Force generation at each Ralltiir location, and did not mention Do They Have A Code Clearance?.<ref name="cardjson"/> The card was errata'd on 12 December 2022 to the text above,<ref name="cardjson"/> and was blanked (removed from the game) on 15 July 2023.<ref name="cardjson"/> GEMP removed its card implementation on 4 May 2024.<ref>[https://github.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/commits/master/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set210/dark/Card210_042.java Card210_042.java history], PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027141656/https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PlayersCommittee/gemp-swccg-public/ecec878b/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set210/dark/Card210_042.java Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Original 0 side text:''' Deploy Ralltiir system. {For} remainder of game, spaceport sites are immune to Always Thinking With Your Stomach, He Hasn't Come Back Yet, and Ounee Ta. Your Force generation is +1 at each Ralltiir location. {While} this side up, once per turn, may deploy a site (or non-unique Imperial) to Ralltiir from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. {Flip} this card if Imperials control at least three Ralltiir sites and opponent controls no Ralltiir locations.
